title: NextPlat Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: NextPlat Corp (NXPL) received notice from Nasdaq on April 27, 2026 that it has regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement ($1.00 per share), closing a listing compliance matter that began in April 2025 when the company's stock price fell below $1.00 for 30 consecutive trading days.
key_points: NextPlat Corp received a delisting notice on April 28, 2025 due to the stock price closing below $1.00 for 30 consecutive trading days
The company was granted a second 180-day grace period expiring April 27, 2026 to regain compliance
On April 27, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that compliance has been restored and the matter is closed
The company's securities (Common Stock: NXPL, Warrants: NXPLW) remain listed on The Nasdaq Stock Market
This is a routine listing compliance matter with no macro or market structure relevance
